details:
I am disappointed that you have put a hard lock on PhysBones for release. I played Quest 2 during the Open Beta and honestly, whether with or without more PhysBones the FPS were about the same. It had virtually no effect on gameplay at all. At this point you have ruined the fun of the new feature for what I assume is 90% of the people playing on Quest. I understand the Quest is a mobile device and won't handle everything as well as a PC, but at least give people the choice if they want literally a few FPS less.
From my observations:
Full world Avatar Dynamics Hub Live version with no PhysBones before their release (16-25 FPS)
Full Avatar Dynamics Open Beta world all people with PhysBones (16-20 FPS)
So do you really need to limit it that much? Now even regular VRoid models with slightly more hair won't work on Quests because they will automatically get Very Poor and exceed the PhysBones limit you imposed.
I have a solution for you:
Instead of restricting it hard just make one extra button for each person disabled by default (whether the Quest player wants to see their PhysBones) then players will have a choice and it will be better. Players will then be able to decide e.g. (well my friend will have his PhysBones turned on for me because I want to see them on Quest, but the rest of the world will have them turned off by default). Alternatively, give Quest players the option to set Performance Very Poor. (Although I agree that if someone has very heavy avatars here with this option it could cause the game to crash), there is another option. Just let them run on Show Avatar (this will not affect the game experience as much as the default setting on Very Poor).
All in all, in my opinion, the first option I gave would be the most sensible. Let the Quest community enjoy what you have created. Don't condemn them to buying a better PC to plug their Quests into so they can see the results of your great work. Please try to please both sides, because right now it looks like you've made a great new thing and suddenly ruined the entire experience for its players using the Oculus Quest 1 and 2 goggles.
title: Avatar Dynamics Hard Lock on Quest
